# scientific_claim_gate

## Purpose
Gate scientific conclusions with ten checks.

## When to use
Before any conclusion output.

## Inputs
Claim + evidence summary.

## Definitions
STRONG / MODERATE / WEAK.

## Procedure
Score ten checks; assign strength.

## QA
Gate result attached to the claim.

## Common failures
Skipping the gate.

## Blocking conditions
Missing provenance.

## Outputs
ClaimAssessment.

## Provenance requirements
stored with the claim.
